caption: Creating a user
preconditions: Seeded newsroom from tools/screenshots/SEED.md (roles Editor and Journalist; users marenholt, tomasvidal, priyaraman, danielokafor, elinesund, lucabrandt)
Database authentication (not LDAP), so Create user opens the form and not the Import user window
steps: Open #/users and wait for [data-test-id="users-list"] [data-test-id="users-list-item"] to be visible

steps.script: const s = document.querySelector('[data-test-id="user-details-form"] #user_role'); const o = [...s.options].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Journalist'); if (o) { s.value = o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }

notes: Do not save: saving would send an activation email and leave a pending user behind. Replaces the inline base64 Create icon and image177.
